title: Aim re-projects the pointer every frame
intent: Keep the player facing the cursor, independent of movement, even while the camera scrolls under a stationary mouse

evidence.description: aim matched the cursor within 0.003 rad while the camera scrolled under a still mouse
Current Git HEAD commit at time of record

constraints.statement: Compute aim from cameras.main.getWorldPoint(pointer.x, pointer.y) every frame, not from pointer.worldX or worldY, which only refresh on mouse events
Sprite rotation follows the cursor only, never the movement direction
